title: Can Compression Garments Reduce the Deleterious Effects of Physical Exercise on Muscle Strength? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analyses
claims: The meta-analysis included 19 randomised controlled trials with 350 healthy participants.

Compression garments produced no strength-sparing effect at any time point: SMD −0.02 (95% CI −0.22 to 0.19) before 24 h; −0.00 (−0.22 to 0.21) at 24–48 h; −0.03 (−0.43 to 0.37) at 48–72 h; 0.14 (−0.21 to 0.49) at 72–96 h; 0.26 (−0.33 to 0.85) at 96 h or later.
The body area where the garment was applied had no strength-sparing effect.
Compression garments showed only weak strength-sparing effects after plyometric exercise.
No likely recovery benefit from compression garments was demonstrated after running, most likely because running causes lower levels of muscle damage than resistance exercise.
Worldwide sales of compression garments reached 5 million pieces with an overall value of USD 45 million in 2019.
The review notes that compression improved running economy and some biomechanical variables, but garment wear was not associated with improved sports performance during high-intensity exercise.

claimVerification.note: 原文摘要 Methods：“Data from 19 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) including 350 healthy participants were extracted and meta-analytically computed.” 正文未复述该合计，仅以 Table 2 列出各项试验并以“Three additional RCTs were included in the qualitative analysis only”说明其中 3 项仅作定性分析。

原文 Results：“After physical exercise, CG versus no CG revealed no effects on muscle strength at any time point: (a) immediately ≤ t < 24 h: SMD = −0.02 (−0.22 to 0.19), p = 0.87; (b) 24 ≤ t < 48 h: SMD = −0.00 (−0.22 to 0.21), p = 0.98; (c) 48 ≤ t < 72 h: SMD = −0.03 (−0.43 to 0.37), p = 0.87; (d) 72 ≤ t < 96 h: SMD = 0.14 (−0.21 to 0.49), p = 0.43; (e) 96 h ≤ t: SMD = 0.26 (−0.33 to 0.85), p = 0.38.” 数值与 claim 完全一致。
原文：“The body area where the CG was applied did not affect strength-related outcomes after exercise (Supplementary Figs. 6–10).”

原文正文：“There was a small and unlikely beneficial dose–response effect of CG after PLYO (SMD = 0.42 [−0.03 to 0.87], p = 0.07, three RCTs)”；摘要作“CGs revealed weak strength-sparing effects after plyometric exercise.” claim 的“weak”取自摘要，但原文同时强调效应不显著（p = 0.07）且仅 3 项 RCT。

原文：“no likely recovery benefits from CGs were demonstrated following running [57] most likely due to the lower levels of muscle damage caused by running compared with RES [58–60].” 注意这是引言转述文献 57 的结果，并非本文 meta 分析所得；claim 未声称是本文发现。
原文：“In 2019, worldwide sales of CGs reached 5 million pieces with an overall value of $45 million [21].”

原文：“whilst the use of CGs improved running economy, biomechanical variables (i.e., ground contact time, step frequency, step length, swing time), and perceived body temperature [40], garment wear was not associated with improved sports performance during high-intensity exercise [41].”
